sets.relationshipLabel: stage that opens the larger whole
sets.explanation: Midnight starts a day the same way January starts a year — each pair names the opening beat of its cycle.

sets.relationshipLabel: power source that lets the timepiece run
sets.explanation: A battery drives a quartz clock and a mainspring drives a mechanical watch — each is the hidden engine behind the ticking.

sets.relationshipLabel: action and the action that undoes it
sets.explanation: Advance and retard are opposite ways to reset a clock's hands, just as start and stop are opposite ways to run one.

sets.relationshipLabel: two counterpart divisions of a cycle
sets.explanation: Weekday and weekend split the calendar week just as tick and tock split the pendulum's single beat.
